# Agentic Systems Engineering: Loops, Context and Harnesses

> Build an agent as a model in a loop calling typed tools, with most of the engineering in the harness. SDAIA Academy course AE-302, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,732 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: From Model to Agent](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day1.md): sessions: Three API shapes, Structured outputs, Tools, The agent loop from scratch; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day1.html; about 6,707 tokens
- [Day 2: Context Engineering](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day2.md): sessions: Context as a budget, Retrieval for agents, Memory, skills and context files, Model Context Protocol; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day2.html; about 4,350 tokens
- [Day 3: Harness and Loop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day3.md): sessions: Anatomy of a harness, Agent SDKs and hosted agents, Loop engineering, Evaluating agents; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day3.html; about 3,541 tokens
- [Day 4: Graph and Production](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day4.md): sessions: State graphs with checkpoints, Several agents and agent-to-agent delegation, Securing agents, Production; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day4.html; about 3,630 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a research agent and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day5.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/slides/day5.html; about 1,071 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: One model, three API shapes](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D1_1_three_shapes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: A berth request as a validated object](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D1_2_structured_outputs.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Typed tools with useful errors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D1_3_typed_tools.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: The agent loop from scratch](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D1_4_agent_loop.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Context as a budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D2_1_context_budget.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Keyword and vector search over circulars](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D2_2_retrieval.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: A context file and a tariff skill](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D2_3_context_skills.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: An MCP server over the circular store](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D2_4_mcp.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Remove one harness part](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D3_1_harness_teardown.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: An agent SDK against your own loop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D3_2_agents_sdk.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Verification inside the loop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D3_3_loop_engineering.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Grading over five trials](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D3_4_evals.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: A booking graph with an approval gate](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D4_1_booking_graph.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Two agents or one?](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D4_2_multi_agent.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: A planted instruction, one leg removed](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-302/labs/D4_3_security.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
